name: share-file
description: Shares a Google Drive file with a person by email as a reader, commenter, or writer, with optional notification and message.

fileId.description: The file or folder ID from search-files or list-recent-files.

email.description: The email address of the person to share with.

role.description: What the person may do: reader (view), commenter or writer (edit). Defaults to reader.

notify.description: Whether Google emails the person about the share. Defaults to true.

message.description: An optional note included in the notification email.
